basics.name: Martin Birkenbaum
basics.label: Senior Software Engineer
basics.summary: Senior Software Engineer with 8+ years of experience designing, building, and deploying large-scale, distributed backend systems and high-throughput microservices. Expertise in cloud infrastructure, GitOps-driven automation, system design, and enhancing developer productivity through robust testing, advanced tooling, and clean code principles.

work.name: Initech Corporation
work.summary: Led architecture and development of high-throughput microservices and GitOps-driven infrastructure pipelines.
highlights: Designed and implemented Python-based event-driven microservices, operating at massive scale to process 10M+ daily events within a distributed system architecture.
Standardized highly reliable containerized deployments across large-scale infrastructure utilizing Docker, Kubernetes, and GitOps workflows, ensuring operational efficiency.
Mentored 6 junior/mid-level engineers, fostering best practices for code quality, system health, and comprehensive testing standards.
Developed custom internal developer toolchains and automation that significantly reduced CI pipeline execution times by 40%, enhancing engineering productivity and release velocity.

work.name: Hooli Inc.
work.summary: Backend engineer focused on building RESTful APIs, developer tooling, and automated deployment integrations.
highlights: Developed robust REST APIs in Python/Django and TypeScript/Node.js, contributing system development code for critical backend services.
Integrated third-party APIs and automated webhook processors, optimizing data flow and communication for external developer platforms.
Implemented a comprehensive suite of unit and integration tests, raising test coverage from 60% to 92% and improving overall software test engineering practices and system reliability.
